name: OmaAmp
author: jonnyace
description: Winamp, reborn on Omarchy. The real Winamp 2.x window on your desktop, pixel-for-pixel, wearing any of 102,000 classic skins from the Skin Museum — live spectrum, docked playlist, MPRIS playback with cliamp as its headless engine — plus a mini music player in the bar. Skins become cliamp and desktop themes; your Omarchy theme dresses the player back.

barWidget.description: A mini music player in the bar — now playing, transport, volume — with the Skin Museum behind it: browse the classics, tune the colors, and dress the player, cliamp, and your whole desktop from one dropdown.
